Pickle Farms is a yield farming product associated with Pickle Finance. Pickle Farms automatically compounds farming rewards. Pickle Farms operates on the Ethereum blockchain.

Synthetix is a protocol that issues synthetic assets. Synthetix uses staked SNX tokens as collateral. Synthetix operates on the Ethereum blockchain.

UniSwapX is a decentralized exchange protocol developed by Uniswap Labs. UniSwapX executes swaps through a Dutch auction mechanism. UniSwapX relies on fillers to execute swap orders. UniSwapX lets users swap without paying gas fees directly.

Raydium is an automated market maker built on the Solana blockchain. Raydium integrates with the OpenBook central limit order book. Raydium offers concentrated liquidity pools. Raydium uses the RAY token.
